ext_desc.message: Translate images on websites - supports comic, manga, manhua, webtoon, doujin translation

options_mode_local.message: Local PaddleOCR + Free Translation or OpenAI

options_langpair_hint.message: It uses ImageTrans project's language pair if the languages are auto. You need to specify the language pair using remote server or PaddleOCR.

options_paddleocr_hint.message: PaddleOCR's ability is limited (lack of language support and options).

options_use_canvas.message: Use Canvas to get image data by default

options_enable_cors.message: Enable CORS headers for cross-domain images

options_font_css_hint.message: Supports full CSS: writing-mode (vertical text), direction (RTL), font, color, background, border-radius, text-shadow, etc.

options_min_font_size_hint.message: Auto-fit font size will never go below this value.

options_use_yolo_detection.message: Use YOLOv8 for text line detection

options_use_yolo_detection_hint.message: Use YOLOv8 to detect text lines, then recognize with PaddleOCR. May improve detection for manga and complex layouts.

options_use_yolo_for_japanese.message: Use YOLO for Japanese text detection

options_use_yolo_for_japanese_hint.message: When source language is Japanese, use YOLOv8 for text line detection.

options_paddle_det_small_hint.message: Detection uses the bundled small model by default — accurate, no download.

options_paddle_rec_small_hint.message: Recognition defaults to tiny (fastest, downloaded from ModelScope on first use). Japanese recognition keeps the bundled small model.

options_paddle_execution_provider_hint.message: WebGPU runs OCR on the GPU and can be much faster on phones, but needs a browser that supports WebGPU. Falls back to WASM automatically. On Firefox, WebGPU is disabled for the regular "WebGPU" option (it can be unstable); choose "WebGPU (Force)" to always try WebGPU. The first run may be slow while shaders compile.

options_paddle_extra_params_hint.message: Passed to PaddleOCR init. Supports det_db_thresh, det_db_box_thresh, det_db_unclip_ratio, erode_size, detMean, detStd, dev (debug visuals) and log.

options_openai_extra_params_hint.message: Merged into the request body, e.g. {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}

options_x_spacing_hint.message: Max horizontal gap for merging adjacent text boxes

options_y_spacing_hint.message: Max vertical gap for merging text lines into blocks

alert_server_url_not_set.message: Server URL is not set. Will use go to the local address.

alert_set_langpair.message: Please set the language pair in the options first (do not choose auto) and then refresh the page.

alert_bad_result.message: Bad result. Is ImageTrans running correctly?

confirm_failed_connect.message:
Failed to connect to local ImageTrans server.

Click OK to use the public server, or Cancel to use local PaddleOCR instead.

Note: PaddleOCR quality is lower than ImageTrans. You can configure which one to use in options.

alert_connect_failed.message: Failed to connect to ImageTrans server.

alert_no_text.message: No text detected in the image.

alert_openai_not_configured.message: OpenAI API URL or Key is not configured. Please set them in the options page.

sc_no_text_detected.message: No text detected in the selected area.

options_screen_capture_overlay_hint.message: Overlay translated text directly on the image instead of showing a dialog.

options_screen_capture_instant_ocr_hint.message: Run OCR immediately after drawing a region, without needing to click Recognize.

options_add_pinyin.message: Add pinyin annotation to Chinese source text

options_add_furigana.message: Add furigana annotation to Japanese source text

options_show_floating_btn_hint.message: Adds a draggable button on pages to quickly translate images.

options_floating_btn_action_hint.message: Choose what happens when you click the floating translate button.

options_save_translation_result_hint.message: Save the original image, translated image and text box data to IndexedDB for each translation.

options_use_translation_cache_hint.message: If a cached result exists in IndexedDB for an image, use it directly instead of re-translating.

options_auto_scroll_hint.message: When auto-translating, scroll to the next untranslated image after each translation completes.

options_text_repair_hint.message: Fill the area behind the translated text with white, a color matched to the local background, or nothing.

cache_read_empty.message: No images to read for the current filter.

cache_read_failed.message: Failed to open the reader page.

cache_filter_placeholder.message: Filter by page URL or title...

cache_confirm_clear.message: Clear all cached results? This cannot be undone.

cache_footer.message: Cached translation results stored in this extension's IndexedDB.
